stories.title: Reese's latest double-double fuels Game 3 rout as Dream take 2-1 Finals lead
stories.summary: Angel Reese kept the Dream rolling in Game 3 with a 97-71 win as Atlanta took a 2-1 lead over the Valkyries in the WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Warriors rookie Lendeborg says he 'lost all respect' for Luka after testy matchup
stories.summary: Yaxel Lendeborg said it was an "interesting first game for me" after defending the Lakers superstar in his professional debut.

stories.title: Clippers dedicate opening win over Kings to banned Ballmer
stories.summary: The Clippers are determined to stay together in the absence of banned owner Steve Ballmer and started the season by routing the Kings 121-96.

stories.title: Giannis says new-look Heat 'got to trust each other more' after blowout loss
stories.summary: Following an opening night blowout loss to the Timberwolves, Giannis Antetokounmpo preached trust as the primary area that needs improvement for the new-look Heat.

stories.title: Hall of Fame hoops coach Huggins has progressive cognitive condition
stories.summary: Hall of Fame college basketball coach Bob Huggins has a progressive cognitive condition that is affecting his memory and aspects of his daily life, his family said.
